fieldNotes.truckGate: Whole dock yard is chain-link fenced; the access road off the public loop road enters the truck yard through a controlled vehicular gate (SPEED LIMIT 15 sign at the fence line). Confirmed in 2026-03 Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible in the truck lane in current satellite or Street View. Small covered structures near the entry are employee break/transit amenities, not a checkpoint. UNFI corporate procedure elsewhere uses guard houses, so a booth may exist but is not visually confirmed here — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true because there is a controlled gate but no visually-confirmed staffed booth; check-in likely via kiosk/intercom. Verify in discovery.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two large connected DC buildings on the UNFI parcel (a north building and a stepped south building). Note: adjacent buildings further NE belong to separate Port of Centralia industrial-park tenants, not UNFI, and are excluded from the perimeter.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 1.15M sq ft DC; long dock banks run the full west face of both buildings plus the south face. 50+ band easily met; ~130 estimated.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large striped trailer drop yard along the west property edge (rows of parked trailers) plus a second drop/staging lot on the NE side. 50+ band.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved internal yard between the gate and the dock face — comfortably holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved gate apron and generous internal yard width; physical room to add a bypass/express lane exists.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in imagery.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Benaroya/UNFI public materials cite a 77-acre site; perimeter box yields ~79 acres including the fenced west yard.

citations.claim: UNFI's FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 2 Properties, lists a distribution centre at "Centralia, Washington" as of 2025-08-02. Our roster address for this record is "4002 Galvin Rd, Centralia, WA 98531".

divestitureCheck.method: Checked against UNFI's FY2025 10-K property table and against its publicly announced 2025-2026 network consolidation. UNFI has closed 12 distribution centres in six years, so presence on the 10-K list alone is not treated as proof of current operation; the announced closures were checked by name.
divestitureCheck.result: present on the FY2025 property list and not named in any announced closure

sources.covers: UNFI network optimisation, the Allentown PA closure, and Central-region consolidations

verification.claimScope: CITY-LEVEL identity only. The 10-K names the city, not the parcel. This record is `probable` rather than `confirmed` because no retrieved source ties UNFI to the specific parcel traced here.
verification.rationale: PROBABLE: UNFI's own SEC 10-K property table lists a distribution centre in Centralia, Washington as of 2025-08-02, and this record sits in that city. That establishes the company operates a DC there. It does NOT establish that the parcel traced here is that DC, and no source retrieved in this pass closes that gap, so the verdict stops at probable.
